faq_heading: Homes near Cliff Drive Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Cliff Drive Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Cliff Drive Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Cliff Drive Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Cliff Drive Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 95 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,507,500, townhomes $740,000, condos $707,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Cliff Drive Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Cliff Drive Elementary the median was 24 days on the market, closing at 97.1% of the list price, with 3% of sales above the list price for the 95 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Cliff Drive Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are du Bois-joli (1.0 km south), South Delta Secondary (1.3 km south-east) and South Park Elementary (1.4 km south-east).

Cliff Drive Elementary is an elementary school in Delta (Delta School District), at 5025 12 Ave. It teaches grades K to 7. Programs listed: Late French Immersion.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Cliff Drive Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the Cliff Drive Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Cliff Drive Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Cliff Drive Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 95 homes sold within 1 km of Cliff Drive Elementary: 52 houses, 19 townhomes and 18 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,507,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Cliff Drive Elementary

7 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Cliff Drive Elementary in a straight line (5 elementary, 1 secondary, 1 other; 1 independent). The closest is du Bois-joli, 1.0 km away, and the farthest on this list is Beach Grove Elementary, 2.2 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is South Delta Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Southpointe Academy (1.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is South Delta Secondary (1.3 km). Other elementary schools close by: du Bois-joli (1.0 km south), South Park Elementary (1.4 km south-east), English Bluff Elementary (1.7 km south), Pebble Hill Traditional Elementary (2.1 km south), Beach Grove Elementary (2.2 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is South Park Elementary, 1.4 km south-east of Cliff Drive Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Cliff Drive Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Delta school finder. A home a few blocks from Cliff Drive Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Cliff Drive Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Cliff Drive Elementary was $1,507,500, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at du Bois-joli, the nearest other elementary school, 1.0 km south of Cliff Drive Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
